name: High Knees
instructions: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart. Run in place, driving one knee up toward your chest as high as possible while pumping the opposite arm.
Quickly alternate legs, landing on the balls of your feet each time and keeping your torso upright and core engaged throughout.
High knees raise the heart rate quickly and reinforce running mechanics. A 150 lb person will burn around 350 calories doing high knees for 30 minutes.
